name: Teelu Rauteli Award
benefit: Under this scheme, one woman or adolescent girl from each district, who has made outstanding achievements in a particular field, is awarded a cash prize of ₹51,000/- along with a certificate of appreciation by the State Government.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a woman or an adolescent girl. 1. The applicant should have made outstanding achievements in any of the following fields: - Social service - Education - Literature - Art and culture - Acts of courage and bravery
